data.one_liner: Widget that presents a view below a movable floating widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating widget that can be dragged to screen corners and lets you present another widget underneath it. The floating view can avoid the keyboard and its size can be configured.
use_when: You need a picture‑in‑picture style overlay in your UI
You want a simple way to show content below a draggable floating widget
avoid_when: You require complex multi‑window management or platform‑specific video pipelines
You need extensive customization beyond the provided corner‑stick behavior
strengths: Very small, only depends on flutter
weaknesses: No built‑in support for multiple floating windows
